name: Packed archive example - cheaper Craft Essences
description: Halves the cost of every Craft Essence, so a deck an 84 limit would refuse fits inside the limit the game actually enforces. The fields are craft_essence.N.cost in member arms_mst_craft_essence.bin of App/zh/rom/mst_data/arms_mst_craft_essence.farc: the rules edit the member and the archive is repacked around it. This is the example for a packed archive: name the member in farc and the rules act on it as text. The whole archive is the unit that gets a baseline and gets restored, so removing the mod puts the original archive back. Every other field is untouched, and battle_cost is deliberately left alone because it is not the deck cost. Not verified in game.
